hypothesis: Prior-close multi-factor cash states applied to the entire portfolio, including the inherited v45 anchor, can improve historical transfer and drawdown robustness more than routing only a small component sleeve.
structural_change: The same causally lagged state gate masks the v45 anchor and both optional components; rejected sessions hold cash.
ranking_boundary: Factors, signs, weights, clocks, quantiles and gates are frozen before evaluation. Ranking uses 2022-2025 only; historical and consumed 2026 are attached after frontier freeze.
falsification: Reject a candidate if any standard, cost, delay, historical, fold, start-date, neighborhood or consumed-2026 gate fails. Full admission also requires inherited-anchor and cumulative multiple-comparison nulls.
classification_boundary: Every survivor remains an inherited-v45 exception unless the inherited anchor and global multiple-comparison nulls independently pass.
